talk_track: At PayPal and Ripple, Daniel Kirichanski's whole job was the problem Bankjoy's VP of Engineering posting describes: release discipline breaking as a fintech engineering org scales. The listing calls it 'a hands-on leadership role at a critical inflection point' and asks for someone who has 'personally rescued or rebuilt automation programs in multi-platform environments.' Read plainly, that is a confession — eight value streams shipping to banks and credit unions without a shared quality framework, with the bar set stream by stream. The role has been open since late May, and every month of the search is a month those standards stay unwritten while credit-union clients keep auditing releases. What worked at payments scale was standing up the release and platform discipline first, so the eventual VP inherits a working system instead of a rescue. While the search runs, who owns release quality across the eight streams?
